justification: Replication directly tested and confirmed essentially all concrete, testable claims using the deposited assemblies: exact chromosome/plasmid lengths (C1), MLST types (C2; capsule not tested), presence/identity of all listed AMR genes (C3), strong nucleotide-level relatedness of the resistance region to cited AbGRI1-related plasmids (C4), BREX Type I locus presence and matching coordinates (C5), phosphonate module (C6), incomplete uric-acid module with missing urate oxidase/HpxO (C7), cytochrome P450 CDS (C8), MPF_I conjugation genes (C9), chromosomal beta-lactamases and quinolone-resistance mutations (C10), and closest plasmid relative pMC1.1 by whole-plasmid similarity (C11). Minor untested aspects (capsule KL/OCL typing; de novo hybrid reassembly; broader comparative/phylogenetic analyses) do not affect the core claims tested, which show no discrepancies.
